title.narrative: Strengthening the Legal and Operational Framework for Vehicle Emissions Standards in Vanuatu

description.narrative: Building on the successful implementation of LECRD Phase 1 in Vanuatu under project VU14, which established the foundation for fuel and vehicle standards adoption by the Government of Vanuatu , Phase 2 of the LECRD program will shift its focus to developing and implementing the necessary legislative and regulatory frameworks. In Vanuatu, LECRD Phase 2 w ill also provide crucial implementation assistance to help ensure effective enforcement of the two policies established in Phase 1. LECRD Phase 2 in Vanuatu (“The Project”) aims to establish the regulatory framework for vehicle emission standards and fuel standards , including its operationalization and targeted implementation support through capacity building and technical assistance (i.e. , standard operational procedures ( SOPs ) ) . To support the government, t h e Project will establish a dedicated team to work with the Ministry of Climate Change (MoCC ), the Ministry of Public Utilities and Infrastructure (MIPU) , and the State Law Office to make the necessary legislative changes to the Vehicle Imports Control Act, CAP221.

The overall objective of the project is to support the Government of Vanuatu in effectively implementing vehicle emission and fuel standards to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and improve air quality. This includes establishing the necessary legislative, regulatory, and operational frameworks, building capacity among relevant authorities, and raising awareness among stakeholders and the public to ensure widespread adoption and compliance with the standards.
